Step 1. Consider the Fredholm operator \(S_{012710011}\) acting on the metric space. By the Fredholm decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|S_{012710011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_012710011\).

Step 2. Consider the measurable operator \(T_{012710012}\) acting on the Harnack space. By the measurable decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{012710012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_012710012\).

Step 3. Consider the meromorphic operator \(A_{012710013}\) acting on the Holder space. By the meromorphic decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|A_{012710013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_012710013\).

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via analytic interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
